avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase seizure risk; imipenem lowers seizure threshold, additive CNS effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue ginseng during imipenem therapy

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Probiotics with Lactobacillus/Bifidobacterium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Imipenem may kill beneficial gut flora; concurrent supplementation may not restore flora adequately during therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; consider probiotics only after therapy completion

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; imipenem can cause seizures and altered mental status
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased CNS effects; use lowest effective dose of valerian

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antibiotic-sparing properties; theoretical reduction in imipenem efficacy
caution_supplements.action: No dose adjustment needed; continue monitoring clinical response

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric absorption if oral formulation used; imipenem is typically IV/IM but relevant if future oral forms considered
caution_foods.action: Administer imipenem with consistent food timing; monitor therapeutic levels if available

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Minor CYP3A4 inhibition; imipenem is not significantly CYP-metabolized but may affect cilastatin component minimally
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required; maintain consistent intake pattern

monitoring_notes: Monitor for seizures, CNS effects, and Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD); assess renal function as imipenem is renally cleared and requires dose adjustment in renal impairment. Screen for penicillin/beta-lactam allergy before initiation.
